name: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 + 74AHCT125
notes: Four outputs: one quad 74AHCT125 per board (RES-031, PRT-006, the maintainer's private notes). WLED builds the S3 with 4 RMT and 8 LCD-parallel channels (https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/v16.0.1/wled00/const.h#L86-L89); the parallel ones would come in as a same_led_type group once a second shifter is fitted.

lead_max_m.src: QuinLED's figure with a level shifter, a 249 ohm resistor and a separate AWG26 or thicker data wire: https://quinled.info/2021/03/10/maximum-length-data-wire-leds-ws2812b-sk6812-ws2815

power_w.src: WLED reserves 120 mA for an ESP32 in its power estimate ("ESP32 about 120mA", MA_FOR_ESP, https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/v16.0.1/wled00/bus_manager.h#L518-L526); 0.12 A x 5 V at the board's 5V pin. The 74AHCT125's own draw is not counted

74AHCT125 quad level shifter.src: one quad 74AHCT125 per board for its four outputs (RES-031, PRT-006, the maintainer's private notes); the S3's 2.64 V high is below the SK6812's 3.4 V input threshold (RES-030, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ahct125.pdf)
